rules: Diagram colours are not delivered jacket colours. Identify by wire ID, pin name and pad.
All power removed before connection or processing.
SHT INT and RST have no external wires.
Each 4-wire probe bare shield is separately insulated; not an extra insertion hole.
Do not join DQ13 and DQ14.
ESP32 uses one Micro-USB power path; no added Pi-ESP GPIO or common-ground wire.

Measured wire-exit-to-cut-end usable length must be compared with the same reference path through the real 3D route and required solder tail. Do not subtract connector body, stripped insulation, 73.40mm or B again.
No pump, valve or fan drive circuit is included.
